# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest version on the default branch. Older versions may not receive security updates.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues or pull requests. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting feature from the repository's **Security** tab. If private reporting is unavailable, contact the maintainer through [GitHub](https://github.com/MaxAndreev27) and request a private reporting channel.

Include the affected version or commit, the impact, and steps to reproduce when safe to share. Please allow the maintainer reasonable time to investigate and coordinate a fix before public disclosure.
